hazard: Inadequate medical care documentation and oversight

reports.title: Mia Gauci-Lamport: Prevention of Future Deaths Report

promises.quote: A recent RQR meeting with TCT has resulted in an agreed plan for them to adopt the national paediatric early warning system (PEWS).
promises.summary: Adopt PEWS to improve monitoring and documentation

promises.quote: TCT agreed to further their connections within the local integrated care system and with tertiary care providers to improve flow to clinical appointments.
promises.summary: Improve referral pathways and collaborative care

promises.quote: The acute trust paediatric nursing colleagues involved in the RQR meeting were positive about the steps TCT had taken so far to review and audit observations and monitoring.
promises.summary: Support TCT with training and education on observation and monitoring

promises.quote: Our NHS England Regional Medical Director has also offered to support with connecting TCT's clinical team to specialists within the NHS that can offer peer support and further improvement work.
promises.summary: Provide peer support and improvement work for TCT clinical team

promises.quote: the CQC inform us that they are monitoring the service to ensure that children residing there are not exposed to risk or unsafe care, which is of utmost importance so deaths such as Mia's can be prevented. CQC regulates the premises and the care provided, and they are reviewing any information received to help inform the next inspection.
promises.summary: CQC monitoring service to prevent unsafe care

promises.quote: NHSE have provided assurance that their regional team has been working with system and other partners on responding to risks and concerns in a joint approach at this provider, which will be set out in their response.
promises.summary: NHSE working with partners on risk response

promises.quote: The Government is supportive of the review on the duty it inherited from the previous administration and will consider the findings, recently published on 26 November, following a call for evidence in April this year. The government will consider these findings alongside findings from the ongoing manager regulation consultation as it continues to develop policy on candour in healthcare.
promises.summary: Government to consider duty of candour findings

promises.quote: On 18th October 2023 CQC requested the outcome of the external investigation from the registered manager at TCT. This wasn't available, but TCT shared the findings with CQC of the internal investigation. Alongside the evidence of findings from the Ofsted inspection the CQC made the decision to await the external investigation findings before scheduling an inspection.
promises.summary: CQC will wait for Ofsted inspection results before scheduling inspection
promises.timescale: await the outcome of Ofsted's inspection

concerns.hazard: inadequate night monitoring of child with seizures

reports.title: Lacey Heath: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: Ms Heath was noted to be warfarin resistant and alternative medication regimes were not successful in keeping Ms Heath within a therapeutic range for her required lifelong requirement to have anticoagulation to prevent a significant risk of death
Ms Heath could not afford to fund the at home monitor as this was financially prohibitive for her being on a low income
No application for funding was made on behalf of Ms Heath by the Trust nor was this explained to Ms Heath
There was an absence of appropriate medical records recorded for Ms Heath to understand her clinical presentation

links.explanation: Both reports highlight failures in maintaining adequate medical records that impede understanding of patients' conditions. The earlier report notes records were incomplete and not up to standard, while the later report describes absent appropriate records leading to lack of appreciation of the patient's concerns.
links.earlier_quote: Mia's medical records at TCT were neither comprehensive nor easy to understand and did not conform to the expected standard
links.later_quote: There was an absence of appropriate medical records recorded for Ms Heath to understand her clinical presentation
